admin.howto_link_title: Where do I find the link?
howto_outlook: Open **outlook.office.com** and go to **Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars**.
Under **Publish a calendar**, pick the calendar and **Can view all details**, then **Publish**.
Copy the **ICS** link (the HTML one only opens in a browser).
admin.howto_outlook_note: If only **Can view when I'm busy** is offered, the door still works, but the list shows “Busy” instead of titles.
howto_google: Open **calendar.google.com** on a computer and go to **Settings** (the gear).
On the left, click the calendar.
Under **Integrate calendar**, copy the **Secret address in iCal format**.
admin.howto_other: Any app that gives you an **ICS** or **iCal** link works; it may start with webcal://.
admin.howto_secret: The link is secret: anyone who has it can read the calendar. It stays on this server and is never shown again.
admin.howto_ticktick_title: How do I get the TickTick link?
howto_ticktick: Open TickTick for desktop or the web and click your avatar → **Settings**.
Go to **Integrations & Import**, and under **Others** open **Subscribe to TickTick**.
Click **Enable the URL**, pick the list and copy the link it makes (it may start with webcal://).
admin.howto_ticktick_note: Tasks due today and overdue ones show on the door; completed tasks are skipped.
howto_kindle: Download the files with the button above and unzip them.
Connect the Kindle with a USB cable and copy the **inkdoor** folder to its root, next to **documents**.
Copy the files in **scriptlets** into the Kindle's **documents** folder. Copy the files, not the folder: replacing **documents** would remove your books.
Eject the Kindle. In its library, open **inkdoor - test connection**, then **inkdoor - start display**.
admin.howto_kindle_note: The Kindle needs a jailbreak that runs scriptlets. To go back to the normal Kindle, restart it.
admin.howto_kpm_intro: If your Kindle has **KPM**, open **inkdoor - connect KPM** in its library once, after installing with the .zip. It adds this server to KPM and installs inkdoor through it.
admin.howto_kpm_upgrade: From then on, to update the Kindle after updating this server, type in its search bar:
admin.howto_kpm_note: The search bar cannot add this server to KPM itself: the Kindle ignores search commands whose words contain a “.” or a “:”, so a web address never gets through.

kindle_zip.readme:
inkdoor for the Kindle
======================

The image address is already set in inkdoor/config.sh:
  {url}

1. Connect the Kindle to the computer with a USB cable.
2. Copy the "inkdoor" folder to the root of the Kindle, next to its "documents" folder.
3. Copy the files in "scriptlets" into the Kindle's "documents" folder.
   Copy the files, not the folder: replacing "documents" would remove your books.
4. Eject the Kindle. In its library, open "inkdoor - test connection",
   then "inkdoor - start display".
5. Optional, if the Kindle has KPM: open "inkdoor - connect KPM" once.
   Later updates are then ";kpm update" and ";kpm upgrade" in the search bar.

To go back to the normal Kindle, restart it (hold the power button).
More help: {docs}
